decision_basis.reason: The pinned upstream maximum of three physical GPT-4o calls for every non-stop logical seeker turn has a six-system uncached worst-case reserve of USD 88.53165 and cannot coexist with the Paper-1 USD 50 hard cap. The execution policy is therefore frozen before capability outcomes rather than chosen after seeing benchmark quality.

upstream_surface.upstream_third_non_stop_handling: take the prefix ending at the last occurrence of ! . ? or ellipsis; preserve raw text if none exists

active_execution_policy.seeker_non_stop: immediately apply the upstream complete-sentence-prefix handling and record the non-stop event; do not resample
active_execution_policy.seeker_transport_retry: at most one separately budget-reserved retry only for a retryable transport failure; never retry because of content or score
active_execution_policy.supporter_non_stop: immediately apply the upstream complete-sentence-prefix handling
active_execution_policy.supporter_one_attempt_reason: The frozen local supporter is greedy and deterministic. Repeating an identical non-stop request three times returns identical bytes and adds only latency; this was observed for every repeated local length event in both compatibility trajectories.
active_execution_policy.formal_method_label: ES-MemEval official prompt, role sequence, rounds, model family and scoring with an explicitly declared one-attempt generation cost amendment

first_consumed_device_deviation.use: consumed engineering evidence only; not the active backend identity

a6000_replay_of_first_supporter_path.conclusion: GPU identity cannot be silently treated as interchangeable for deterministic generation

combined_pilot_family.interpretation: Execution compatibility is established for the sampled trajectories. The 20/20 stop result is descriptive and is not used as a statistical guarantee or a capability pass gate.

budget_consequence.remaining_requirement: Before formal DG, reconcile the one-attempt seeker reserve, official GPT-4o overall scoring, other RQ2 tasks and already settled cost in one exact call manifest; do not assume the old USD 22 RQ2 estimate remains valid.
